query: A pharmacy chain needs to replenish its drug inventory. The ‘products.csv’ file provides a table of benefits associated with each drug product. There are overall stock capacity limits for pharmacy chains detailed in the ‘capacity.csv’ file.Our objective is to decide which drugs to order each day and in what quantities to maximise the overall benefit while adhering to the overall stock capacity. The decision variable x_i represents the number of units of the ith drug to be ordered each day.

Variables:
- \( x_i \in \mathbb{Z}_+ \) (nonnegative integers), for \( i = 1, \ldots, 20 \)

Objective:
\[
\max \left(
250x_1 + 178x_2 + 313x_3 + 301x_4 + 425x_5 + 260x_6 + 848x_7 + 934x_8 + 114x_9 + 1357x_{10} + 156x_{11} + 1780x_{12} + 695x_{13} + 405x_{14} + 320x_{15} + 320x_{16} + 1357x_{17} + 1357x_{18} + 405x_{19} + 998x_{20}
\right)
\]

Subject to (stock capacity constraint):
\[
913x_1 + 754x_2 + 428x_3 + 711x_4 + 350x_5 + 159x_6 + 353x_7 + 291x_8 + 302x_9 + 50x_{10} + 250x_{11} + 178x_{12} + 313x_{13} + 378x_{14} + 94x_{15} + 97x_{16} + 470x_{17} + 341x_{18} + 121x_{19} + 61x_{20} \leq 520
\]

and

x_i \in \mathbb{Z}_+, \quad \forall i = 1, \ldots, 20
\]

- \( x_i \) = number of units of drug i to order each day (integer, nonnegative)
- The coefficients in the objective are the "Value" from products.csv
- The coefficients in the constraint are the "Weight" from products.csv
- The right-hand side is the "Capacity" from capacity.csv

This model maximizes the total benefit from the ordered drugs, subject to the overall stock capacity.
